ACGL.thesis: A disciplined, lowly levered specialty insurer earning high-teens ROE trades below peers and low in its own EV/EBITDA range while in a healthy uptrend, with buybacks compounding per-share value through a softening cycle.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 12%, showing the soft cycle is eroding returns beyond a normal cyclical dip.
TTM ROE falls below 14%, well under the 18.7% now, signalling underwriting returns have broken down.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 1.5x, reversing the deleveraging.
Reinsurance net premiums written decline by more than 15% year on year for two consecutive quarters in the 10-Q.

CI.thesis: A deleveraging PBM and employer-health franchise with rising ROIC of 12.7% and a 10.40% FCF yield trades near the bottom of its own 5-year P/E range and below its EV/EBITDA minimum, where the price implies a revenue decline that raised 2026 guidance does not show.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 10%, giving up most of the five-year improvement from 8.8% to 12.7%.
TTM operating margin falls below 3.5%, under the FY2025 five-year low of 3.7%, showing rebate reform or medical cost pressure is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM FCF margin falls below 2.0%, well under the current 2.9%, signalling cash generation and buyback capacity are deteriorating.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 2.5x (1.87x TTM now), reversing the deleveraging.

DECK.thesis: A net-cash, very high-return footwear brand owner with flat margins and ROCE at its 2-year high trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 9.08% FCF yield, pricing a revenue decline its slowed-but-positive outlook does not show.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the FY2024 level of 55.6%, showing rival discounting or markdowns are eroding full-price discipline.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 18.0%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 14%, showing the inventory build is turning into cash and margin stress rather than a seasonal swing.
TTM ROIC falls below 55%, showing the decline from 78.5% is no longer inventory timing but eroding returns.

GDDY.thesis: A deleveraging, high-return domain and SMB-software franchise with a 33.7% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a revenue decline that growing bookings and high-end guidance do not show.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year improvement from 12.5% (FY2021) to 28.7%.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, erasing the post-2023 step-up (FY2024 20.4%).
TTM FCF margin falls below 25%, under the FY2024 level of 27.6%, showing the cash gains were transitory.
Total bookings growth in the 10-Q/earnings release falls below 4% y/y for two consecutive quarters (AI substitution showing in demand), or net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x.

HKG:0291.thesis: A net-cash Chinese brewer with rising operating and FCF margins trades below its own 5-year minimum cash multiples, pricing shrinkage that its improving operations do not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 12.0% (14.9% now), reversing the mix and pricing gains.
TTM FCF margin falls below 10.0% (15.3% now), showing the cash step-up was transitory.
TTM ROIC falls below 10.0% (11.9% now), below the FY2025 low of 10.4%.
Net debt/EBITDA (debt minus cash and short-term investments, balance sheet / ratios page) turns positive from -1.55x TTM, i.e. net cash is gone.

HKG:3998.thesis: China's leading down-jacket brand, with 81.2% ROIC, net cash and an 11.92% FCF yield, trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales, where the price implies a -12.9% revenue decline its margins and cash flow do not show.

TTM net margin falls below 10%, reversing the five-year rise to 14.6% and indicating the brand premium has eroded.
TTM ROIC falls below 40%, a reversion toward FY2022 levels that undercuts the moat thesis.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 five-year low of 12.2%, signalling inventory or working-capital stress from a demand down-cycle.

HKG:9999.thesis: A net-cash games franchise with operating margin rising to 35.2% and a 43.5% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a revenue decline its improving fundamentals do not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 28.1%, reversing the five-year expansion.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 36.5%, signalling cash generation is no longer keeping pace.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2024 level of 62.5%, indicating game-portfolio mix or monetization is deteriorating.
A new PRC regulation materially restricts game monetization, or a VIE-related regulatory action forces deconsolidation, as disclosed in a company filing or release.

HRB.thesis: A high-return, cash-rich assisted tax-prep franchise whose fundamentals remain stable, but whose multiples have re-rated from the bottom of its own 5-year range to the middle, so the remaining upside is mostly shareholder yield rather than re-rating.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 43%, breaking the five-year range (44.3%-45.7%), signalling price pressure from free/AI filing alternatives.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, under the FY2022 five-year low of 21.5%, showing the margin expansion has reversed.
TTM FCF margin falls below 15%, under the FY2025 low of 15.9%, meaning cash generation no longer funds buybacks and the dividend.
Trailing ROCE on the ratios page falls below 35%, or annual revenue declines year on year, or management discloses a loss of assisted-category share.

INTU.thesis: A net-cash, 40%-FCF-margin financial-software franchise with ROIC and margins at their 2-year highs on a rolling basis trades at the floor of its own 5-year multiples, pricing near-zero growth that delivered results contradict.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 16%, giving up the rise from 18.5% a year earlier to 22.9% and signalling the returns expansion has reversed.
TTM FCF margin falls below 30%, back near the FY2024 level of 28.8%, meaning the FY2026 cash step-up was transitory.
TTM gross margin falls below 78%, under the FY2023 five-year low of 79.3%, signalling free/AI tax-filing competition is forcing price cuts.

Consumer segment revenue (10-Q) declines year on year for two consecutive reported periods, or Global Business Solutions revenue growth falls below 10% for a full year, showing free filing and AI eroding the base.

JKHY.thesis: A high-return, unlevered core-banking franchise with rising rolling returns and cash margins and raised guidance, trading below its own 5-year median multiples, but whose price now implies growth above the company's framework.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 19%, the FY2024 trough, evidencing moat erosion.
TTM operating margin falls below 22%, under the FY2024 low of 22.1%, showing cloud/AI/security investment or renewal pricing is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM FCF margin falls below 20%, reversing the rising trend (TTM 27.6%).
Processing revenue growth in the 10-Q MD&A falls below 5% year on year for two consecutive quarters, or core client losses outnumber wins.

LDOS.thesis: A government-IT incumbent with ROIC still well above its FY2021-23 levels and an 11.0% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum on every earnings multiple and below peers, where the price implies a -11.6% revenue decline that raised EPS guidance does not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 10.5%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 8.5% to 11.8% and showing contract completions are not being replaced at similar margins.
TTM ROIC falls below 13%, showing the decline from 16.6% is no longer a temporary acquisition denominator effect but deteriorating returns.
TTM FCF margin falls below 8%, back to the level of a year earlier, showing the cash step-up was transitory.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x (2.46x TTM now) without a visible deleveraging path from the Entrust debt.

OTIS.thesis: A service-led elevator franchise with high and recovering returns and improving cash conversion still trades below its own 5-year multiple range, but after the rebound the price sits above the mechanical fair value while operating margin is falling and leverage rising, leaving a balanced rather than compelling skew.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2021 5-year low of 15.2% (15.5% now), showing the labour and material cost squeeze is structural.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 5-year low of 10.0% (11.1% now), showing the cash recovery was transitory.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.5x (3.12x TTM now), showing capital returns are outrunning cash generation.
Service organic sales growth in the 10-Q MD&A falls below 3% in any quarter, or FY26 adjusted free cash flow guidance is cut below 1.4bn USD.

TYO:2875.thesis: A net-cash, high-ROIC Japanese noodle and food maker trading at the low end of its own P/E range and well below peers.

triggers.text: ROIC (TTM) falls below 18%
Operating margin (TTM) falls below 14%
FCF margin (TTM) falls below 6%

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2023 5-year low of 35.9%, showing competition is eroding profitability, not just growth.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2022 5-year low of 69.7%, signalling structural loss of pricing power.
TTM ROIC falls below 22%, a clear break below the five-year range, showing the moat's returns are eroding.
Companion-animal revenue declines for two further consecutive quarters with dermatology share loss cited in the 10-Q MD&A, or 2027 guidance implies a total revenue decline.
